summary: ZA/UM's narrative detective RPG property, with the PC Final Cut as the definitive full-game route and a later Android reimagining documented separately.

entries.title: Disco Elysium
entries.definitive_edition: Disco Elysium - The Final Cut on Windows

emulation.notes: Use the native PC Final Cut release; no emulator route is needed.

primary.version: Disco Elysium - The Final Cut PC release
primary.why: The Final Cut adds full voice acting, new political vision quests, controller support, quality-of-life improvements, and the complete content set. Windows remains the highest-fidelity and most controllable archive route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Disco Elysium - The Final Cut on Windows through Steam/GOG/Epic with current patches; use console versions only if a console capture route is required.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Final Cut changes the presentation through full voice acting and new political vision quests; no older original-cut route is needed for exclusive story content.

entries.title: Disco Elysium Mobile

emulation.notes: Use the official Google Play release on compatible Android hardware.

primary.why: This is a distinct Android reimagining built for mobile sessions and 360-degree scenes rather than the full desktop-style Final Cut presentation. Android is the documented public release route.
primary.how_to_play: Play through the official Google Play release if specifically sampling the mobile adaptation; choose the Windows Final Cut entry for the full definitive game.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a mobile reimagining/adaptation rather than the recommended full-game route.
